policy: Original measurement document and sequence strictly before connected game-canvas context loss. Deduplicate storage notifications by texture identity; mip notifications are not literal upload calls. SRGB8_ALPHA8 (35907) is uncompressed and excluded. Recognized compressed formats use the exact glbytes BLOCK set (including all ASTC block sizes). No raw subimage tracing or new GPU probes.

findings.creator: PineCrags.load -> awaited loadPBR(mossy_rock) -> cragMaterial -> pine.crag patch uniforms tRockD/tRockN/tRockA
findings.lateFetchBasis: PineCrags.load awaits Promise.all(loadPBR(...)) before constructing cragMaterial; ForestLandmarks awaits that promise before crag build.
findings.registryMissBasis: cragMaterial has no material map properties or material.uniforms. Its closure u is assigned into shader.uniforms inside patchShader, with no opts.textures. collectTextures visits material-own values, explicit shaderPatchTextures, and material.uniforms; it cannot inspect this closure.
findings.likelyIssuePhase: First composer render after Phase C (inference from source flow and late storage ordering; no timestamped warm-up completion hook in this light run).
findings.faultingTexture: Unresolved: compressedTexSubImage2D is not recorded by light journal; asynchronous GPU queue plus native stack do not identify exact texture or mip. Last three named allocations are candidates, not a unique proven culprit.
findings.proposedOwnerFix: Register ALL crag shader input textures through patchShader opts.textures, including shared grit inputs, then let Phase C perform the normal compressed-texture GPU round trip before composer draws. No rendering changes made in this receipt.
